home.heroText: The Ukrainian International Institute of Restoration (UIIR) is a professional expert institution established to coordinate scientific, architectural, engineering and analytical capacity in territorial development, infrastructure planning, community transformation and the delivery of integrated project solutions.
paragraphs: The Ukrainian International Institute of Restoration (UIIR) is a professional expert institution established to coordinate scientific, architectural, engineering and analytical capacity in territorial development, infrastructure planning, community transformation and the delivery of integrated project solutions.

The Institute brings together researchers, highly qualified practitioners, representatives of local self-government, subject-matter experts and partners to shape contemporary solutions in architecture, urban planning, community development, strategic planning and infrastructure development.

UIIR supports territorial development, infrastructure modernization, strategic planning, the preparation of project solutions and interdisciplinary initiatives in cooperation with communities, institutions and international partners.
home.missionQuote: To consolidate scientific, professional and expert capacity to shape modern solutions for territorial development, strategic planning, infrastructure transformation and integrated community development projects.
home.ctaText: We welcome partnership, expert and project collaboration in territorial and infrastructure development.

about.title: About UIIR
intro: The Ukrainian International Institute of Restoration was established in 2023 as an extraterritorial, non-profit professional organization coordinating expert, scientific and project support in territorial development, spatial planning, infrastructure transformation and the restoration of Ukraine.
UIIR is a non-profit organization under the current legislation of Ukraine and does not aim to generate profit.

The Institute operates as a platform for professional cooperation between the scientific community, practitioners, communities, local self-government bodies, specialized institutions and international partners.
about.centersIntro: UIIR includes the following specialized centers:
centers: Center for Architectural and Spatial Design
Center for Community and Regional Development

Center for Analytics, Management and Project Support

about.orgIntro: The highest governing body of UIIR is the General Meeting of authorized representatives of local self-government bodies — members of the Association.
about.orgPowersIntro: The powers of the General Meeting include:
orgPowers: electing the First Vice President — Executive Director of UIIR
determining the Institute’s strategic areas of activity
about.orgManagement: Between meetings of the General Meeting, UIIR is managed by the UIIR Board, which makes decisions on all matters of the Institute’s statutory activity that do not fall within the exclusive competence of the General Meeting.
about.principlesIntro: UIIR is based on the principles of:
principles: independence in determining areas of activity
mission: To consolidate scientific, professional and expert capacity to shape modern solutions for territorial development, strategic planning, infrastructure transformation and integrated community development projects.

The Ukrainian International Institute of Restoration brings together researchers, architects, engineers, analysts, representatives of local self-government and international partners to provide professional support to territorial communities, prepare strategic solutions and deliver projects focused on modernization, development and transformation across Ukraine.

UIIR creates an environment for interdisciplinary cooperation where expertise, science, project-based methods and practical experience come together to build long-term solutions for territorial and infrastructure development.

vision.title: Consolidating professional capacity
paragraphs: UIIR is developing as a professional expert platform that enables cooperation between communities, local self-government bodies, specialized institutions, the scientific community, international partners and investors for integrated territorial development projects.
The Institute is building a professional support system for communities in strategic planning, spatial development, infrastructure modernization, architecture and engineering.

vision.title: Strategic planning and territorial development
paragraphs: UIIR is preparing territorial development and transformation projects today, creating a foundation for the long-term implementation of strategic initiatives in the future.
The Institute supports the development of:
items: models for attracting partnership and investment support

vision.title: Effective partnerships
paragraphs: One of UIIR’s core principles is to build an effective partnership model between public institutions, communities, the expert environment, international partners and the professional community.
The Institute fosters an open environment for coordination, professional dialogue and interdisciplinary project delivery.

vision.title: Educational and scientific development
paragraphs: UIIR supports the development of modern educational and scientific infrastructure as a foundation for long-term territorial development.
items: professional education in architecture, engineering and infrastructure development
